summary: End-to-end testing of the new 'Entregar y cobrar' + 'Vender con deuda' flows. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass in test_deliver_sell.py covering: (a) deliver_repair with paid<cost creates ingreso tx (category=reparacion, related_repair_id) AND debt (source=reparacion) with remainder; (b) deliver_repair with paid=cost creates only tx, no debt; (c) deliver_repair with paid=0 creates ONLY debt (no zero-amount transaction) and status→entregado; (d) overpay is capped to cost; (e) negative paid → 400; (f) sell_phone partial pay creates both tx and debt with client_name/client_phone from body; (g) sell_phone full pay creates only tx; (h) missing client_name falls back to 'Cliente sin nombre'; (i) default paid=price; (j) sold-out returns 400; (k) paying the auto-created debt via /debts/{id}/pay correctly sums into caja today ingresos. Regression suite test_debts.py + test_api.py continue to pass. Frontend (Playwright mobile 390x844): repair edit sheet → tap status-option-entregado does NOT immediately change status but opens the deliver sheet with input-deliver-paid (prefilled with cost), chip-deliver-method-{efectivo,transferencia,tarjeta}, btn-confirm-deliver. Confirmed with paid=1500 on cost=2000 → status becomes entregado AND a debt of RD$ 500 appears in Deudas with 'Pendiente' badge under the client name. In Inventario, sell sheet input-sell-paid is prefilled with sell price (verified '6000'), sell-debt-box is HIDDEN when paid=price and APPEARS when paid<price (verified debt box with client-name & phone inputs). Confirming sell with paid=4000/price=6000 + client 'TEST_PW_SELL_*' created a debt of RD$ 2,000 visible in Deudas list. Cross-module integration verified: created debts appear under 'Pendientes' and can be paid via 'Registrar pago', pumping ingreso into caja summary/today.

Frontend testIDs are complete and match spec: status-option-entregado, input-deliver-paid, chip-deliver-method-{efectivo|transferencia|tarjeta}, btn-confirm-deliver in reparaciones.tsx; input-sell-paid, sell-debt-box, input-sell-client, input-sell-client-phone in inventario.tsx.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints: POST /api/repairs/{id}/deliver {paid, method}. POST /api/phones/{id}/sell now accepts {price, paid, method, client_name, client_phone, description}. Both return {transaction, debt, paid, pending, ...}. Deliver: paid=0 → NO tx, only debt; paid=cost → only tx; paid<cost → both. Sell: same pattern. Debts created carry source='reparacion'|'venta', related_repair_id / related_phone_id. Paying such debts via /api/debts/{id}/pay creates a linked ingreso tx in caja. Baseline DB after cleanup: 3 debts (Juan soto/Reparación pending 500, and prior Maria Lopez venta parcial 5500). Key frontend testIDs on deliver sheet: input-deliver-paid, chip-deliver-method-<m>, btn-confirm-deliver. On sell sheet: input-sell-amount (price), input-sell-paid, sell-debt-box, input-sell-client, input-sell-client-phone, btn-confirm-sell.
